Spectral indices from satellite bands

geo_spectral_index.Rd

geo_spectral_index() computes common normalised-difference indices from a multi-band image (Sentinel-2, Landsat, drone imagery), as in GeoSpaX's Forestry plug-in. Each index is (a - b) / (a + b):

indexBands (a, b)Measures
"NDVI"NIR, redgreen vegetation
"GNDVI"NIR, greenchlorophyll
"NDRE"NIR, red edgecanopy chlorophyll (Sentinel-2 B05)
"NDWI"green, NIRopen water (McFeeters)
"MNDWI"green, SWIR1open water in built-up areas
"NDMI"NIR, SWIR1vegetation moisture
"NBR"NIR, SWIR2burned areas
"NDBI"SWIR1, NIRbuilt-up land

Name the band layers with bands, for example bands = c(red = "B04", nir = "B08"). Sentinel-2 names (B03, B04, B05, B08, B11, B12) are recognised automatically.

With threshold = "otsu", the index is also split into two classes by Otsu's method (the cut that best separates the two peaks of the histogram), and the area above the cut is reported, for example vegetated or water area.

Usage

geo_spectral_index(
  x,
  index = c("NDVI", "GNDVI", "NDRE", "NDWI", "MNDWI", "NDMI", "NBR", "NDBI"),
  bands = NULL,
  threshold = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A multi-band SpatRaster or file path.

index

Index name (see table).

bands

Named character vector mapping red, green, nir, rededge, swir1, swir2 to layer names of x.

threshold

NULL (no classes), "otsu", or a number.

Value

A SpatRaster with the index; with a threshold, a second layer above (1/0), and attribute "threshold" with the cut value, the area above it (km^2) and its share of valid cells.

References

Otsu, N. (1979). A threshold selection method from gray-level histograms. IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics, 9, 62-66. doi:10.1109/TSMC.1979.4310076

Examples

# Sentinel-2 Level-2A bands over Luxembourg, 24 August 2024 (terra)
s2 <- terra::rast(system.file("ex/sent2_L2A_2024-08-24.tif", package = "terra"))
ndvi <- geo_spectral_index(s2, "NDVI", threshold = "otsu")
ndvi
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 90, 95, 2  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 0.008333333, 0.008333333  (x, y)
#> extent      : 5.741667, 6.533333, 49.44167, 50.19167  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
#> source(s)   : memory
#> varnames    : sent2_L2A_2024-08-24
#>               sent2_L2A_2024-08-24
#> names       :     NDVI, above
#> min values  :  0.12161, FALSE
#> max values  : 0.638247,  TRUE
attr(ndvi, "threshold")

#> [1] "NDVI"
